narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to explain a scientific mystery: how the massive Moai statues on Easter Island were transported. It contrasts traditional 'rolling log' theories with new evidence suggesting the statues were engineered to 'walk' by rocking side-to-side when pulled by ropes.
